What is the equation of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
From the diagram we see that the arms of the parabola open to the right. The parabola has its vertex at $(0,0)$ and passes through the point $(12,4).$

The general standard equation of a parabola whose vertex is $(0,0)$ and whose arms open right or left is given by

$$
{y}^{2}=4px.
$$

Since we know the given parabola passes through the point $(12,4),$ we can substitute $x=12$ and $y=4$ into the standard equation and solve for $p:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ {4}^{2} & =4p(12) \\ 16 & =48p \\ p & =\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

So, the equation of the parabola is 

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ {y}^{2} & =4(\frac{1}{3})x \\ {y}^{2} & =\frac{4}{3}x.\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that the arms of the parabola open to the right since $p=\frac{1}{3}$ is positive.
